scope: P5 Gas Quarterly (Mission Quarterly, product Gas) for arms A0 Calendar-only baseline and A1 S1 candidate.
method: One row per important information requirement (not per file). Each row carries the eight frozen §6.3 fields. Availability and candidate data-readiness use their separate canonical namespaces and are never merged.

rows.requirement: Eligible Gas Quarterly campaign list and exact campaign dates
rows.missionAndCandidate: Quarterly (Gas) / A0 Calendar-only baseline + A1 S1 candidate

missing.reason: No campaign dataset exists in the inspected material; the exact eligible list is populated later from the audited dataset (S-08 p.5).
missing.nextRetrievalAction: Provide the audited list of eligible Gas Quarterly campaigns with exact dates and contract identity.

rows.shortValidationNote: Campaign identity/date is a prerequisite for both arms; without it the population cannot be instantiated.

evidence.locator: p.4 cantidades comunicadas; MW != MWh, horas/perfil ausentes

rows.shortValidationNote: Historical communicated quantity with incomplete unit is provenance only and is not an executable obligation (S-06 p.4; S-13 p.2).

rows.requirement: Procurement calendar: trading days, opportunities, deadline, pause/excluded month

missing.reason: Only benchmark reference windows are documented; no real procurement calendar, deadline or pause exists in the inspected material.
missing.nextRetrievalAction: Provide the real procurement window, decision opportunities, deadline and any pause/excluded-month structure.

rows.shortValidationNote: The benchmark window is an economic reference and does not authorize execution inside the excluded month (S-01 §5.3 L389).

rows.requirement: Execution price series at eligible decision boundaries for the exact Gas Quarterly contract

missing.reason: No price, trade or order-book series exists in the workspace; S-05 describes an external repository not present here.
missing.custodianRole: Data owner/custodian (market-data provider responsible for the EEX price feed)
missing.nextRetrievalAction: Provide a hashable extract of the exact Gas Quarterly contract price/trade/top-of-book series with timestamps, units and coverage.

rows.shortValidationNote: Without executable prices neither the calendar arm nor the S1 arm can produce fills or H.

rows.requirement: S1 causal price references (price at decision timestamp and reference construction history)

missing.reason: S1 requires a causal price at the exact decision timestamp plus reference construction; no price series exists to build or verify it. S1 parameters are explicitly not chosen in this ST.
missing.custodianRole: Research owner (S1 instantiation, IMP-11) + data owner/custodian
missing.nextRetrievalAction: After a price series exists, instantiate S1 references/lookbacks under IMP-11 with frozen configuration and provide PIT evidence.

rows.shortValidationNote: S1 references must be causal and point-in-time valid; no reference series exists to demonstrate this (S-01 §8.1 L711).

rows.requirement: Benchmark B reference prices (official EEX settlement or derived provisional) per trading date

historicalCoverage.value: One selected reference per trading date; 1-0-1/3-1-3 averaging (methodology only)

pointInTimeValidity.note: B is evaluation-view only; it must never be visible to the decision policy (S-01 §5.3 L389).

rows.shortValidationNote: Methodology is documented but no official or derived reference rows exist; proxy equivalence is explicitly not proven (S-05 §5 L126).

missing.reason: No fee schedule, spread/slippage, latency, fill rule or lot/rounding specification exists in the inspected material.
missing.nextRetrievalAction: Provide the real audited execution parameters (fees, spread/slippage, latency, fill/partial rules, lot size/rounding) for the exact Gas Quarterly contract.

rows.shortValidationNote: Unknown costs are never replaced by zero; until audited, economic interpretation stays HOLD (S-01 §13.6 L1221-1222).

rows.shortValidationNote: Reservation requires >=2 years of eligible history; insufficient history => HOLD (S-01 §24 DEP-12; S-08 p.10).

candidates.rationale: Critical shared inputs are missing: campaign identity/calendar (R-01/R-03), obligation/unit (R-02/R-08), execution prices (R-04), benchmark B references (R-06), costs (R-07), PIT/publication evidence (R-09/R-10), timezone/DST (R-11), permissions (R-12) and OOS eligibility (R-17). A critical requirement missing means the candidate is not DATA_READY (S-01 §6.3 L566).

Inherits every critical missing input of A0 (including the benchmark B references R-06) and additionally lacks the S1 causal price references (R-05). No S1 parameters were chosen in this ST; readiness cannot be claimed without a causal, PIT-valid price reference.

readinessConclusion: Both P5 Gas Quarterly candidates are DATA_BLOCKED on factual absence of real data. The 2020-2026 range is a communicated input pending audit, not certified coverage (S-01 §6.4 L570; S-07 p.8; S-10 p.6). A negative audit is a valid completion: it prevents DATA_READY rather than fabricating availability.
